text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from. Many debugging tools can help you, such as breakpoints and error messages. However, a systematic approach is often more effective than guessing. Check your code step by step and test each part. Logging is also very useful. By adding log statements, you can see what your program is doing and where it fails. With patience and good methods, you can solve most bugs and improve your coding skills.
